cap: After the placenta is delivered, the estrogen and progesterone block on prolactin lifts, so prolactin makes milk and suckling-driven oxytocin causes let-down. Prolactin also suppresses GnRH pulses, which causes lactational amenorrhea, and classic galactosemia in the infant forbids breastfeeding. Mood changes are graded by severity: blues fade within 2 weeks, postpartum depression lasts longer and needs treatment, and postpartum psychosis is an emergency.
